Résumé
I'm a Network Engineer with 3+ years of experience designing,
building, and maintaining enterprise-grade network infrastructures
that keep global organizations connected, secure, and operational.
Most recently at Hewlett Packard Enterprise, I specialized in network
access control and security, having configured and optimized 200+
HPE Aruba ClearPass environments for major clients including
banks, insurance companies, service providers, and universities
worldwide.I thrive on solving complex network challenges. Be it
designing LAN/WAN architectures from scratch, troubleshooting
critical connectivity issues, or replicating existing networks for
analysis and improvement, I combine deep technical expertise with
rapid problem-solving to deliver results. My track record includes
reducing authentication failures by 90%, cutting support ticket
resolution time by 70%, and consistently minimizing downtime for
mission-critical systems.My technical toolkit spans network security
(RADIUS, PKI, NAC), routing and switching (OSPF, VLAN, VPN),
infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible), and comprehensive
monitoring solutions (Prometheus, Grafana). As a fast learner
and independent thinker, I quickly adapt to new technologies and
environments.Beyond hands-on engineering, I analyze requirements,
recommend tailored solutions, and ensure servers, operating
systems, and core infrastructure remain secure and performing at
peak efficiency.I'm currently exploring new opportunities where I can
apply my expertise in network engineering, systems administration,
and IT consulting to help forward-thinking organizations build
resilient, high-performance infrastructures. Fluent in Arabic, English,
and working knowledge in French, I bring both technical excellence
and clear communication to every project; ready to make an
immediate impact on my next team.
